headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Tracking runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are now limited war 66%, escalated 15%, MOU-style 12% and comprehensive 7%. Trump confirmed on Fox that US jets struck an Iranian air-defense site on Qeshm Island, which fires the US-strike tripwire, but he called it a minor, defensive hit and talks through Qatar go on, so it moves the odds by less than the set effect: escalated is up 3 points and a deal is less likely. Iran says the US reply is not convincing and vows a response, and mediators expect answers from both sides within 36 hours.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
